approach: Static ahead-of-time translation of the retail ARM/Thumb binary to native C++, held strict fully-static (zero interpreter fallback) by a self-healing coverage loop
notes: Full playthrough on Windows, Linux and Android — menus, battles, event scripts, cartridge saves and save states. Launch screen with box art and a native ROM picker. Validated widescreen view up to 448 px. GBA screen simulation: raw, unlit, frontlit, backlit and classic. In-game shader stack: MMPX edge smoothing, sharp scaling, pixel grid, LCD subpixel grille, LCD boost, dither and deband; frame interpolation and LCD ghosting. Fast-forward: hold Tab/2/right trigger or latch the on-screen FF pill; 2–10x speed set under Assist. Keyboard, controller and touch input. The Steam Deck/SteamOS AppImage ships with Game Mode defaults. Release artifacts are ROM-less; the ROM is user-supplied and hash-verified at launch, and the launch BIOS is bundled clean-room emibios. Experimental preview — back up saves and report repeatable crashes.
